preregistered_hypothesis: With allocation.dt=86400 s and solver.saveat=3600 s, the initial 32 m3/day priority allocation would remain frozen for the one-day physical realization window.

observed_failure.gate: root allocation differs from preregistered priority split
observed_failure.implication: The management allocation present after the run is not the preregistered 32/0 m3/day root-first split.

pinned_source_reconciliation.allocation_time_initialization: core/src/read.jl::AllocationTime initializes allocation.time.tstops on the solver.saveat grid.
pinned_source_reconciliation.fixed_dt_cap: core/src/model.jl::compute_next_allocation_tstop uses allocation.dt for fixed timestepping but caps the next solve at first(allocation.time.tstops), which includes saveat boundaries.
pinned_source_reconciliation.repeated_solve: core/src/model.jl::loopheader! calls update_allocation! whenever the integrator reaches an allocation.time.tstop.
pinned_source_reconciliation.state_feedback: core/src/allocation_optim.jl::set_simulation_data!(::Basin) rebuilds the optimization from current_storage at every solve.
pinned_source_reconciliation.user_documentation_tension: docs/reference/usage.qmd describes allocation.dt as the fixed allocation update interval and solver.saveat as output frequency, while the pinned implementation couples allocation solves to saveat boundaries.

scientific_effect: The intended one-day frozen management allocation was not actually the model execution semantics at solver.saveat=3600 s. Hourly output boundaries can expose newly retained Basin storage to repeated allocation optimization within the nominal one-day allocation.dt.
